name: rdm_app_attr
label: CMDB Configuration Item Attribute Table
description: Configuration item attributes table for research and development management, enabling status filtering, and query scenarios for related associations.

fields.name: id
fields.description: ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: app_id
fields.description: Retrieve the ID of the rdm_object. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: name
fields.description: English name. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: validator_id
fields.description: The component ID for the validator needs to be implemented in the code.

fields.name: is_private
fields.description: Private attribute, system default attribute, cannot be deleted.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the ID field, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_name
indexes.description: Standard index covering the name field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: uk_app_stat_key
indexes.description: Unique index covering the app_id, stat_key fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.

indexes.name: uk_name
indexes.description: Unique index covering the app_id, name, is_private fields, suitable for exact-match retrieval, uniqueness checks, and duplicate detection.
